dedupeText: vintage pop rock compilation cover 1960s mod collage primary colors band portrait comic art reissue contrast between the dark moody photography and the vibrant flat color graphic panels hierarchy established by the oversized blue display type at the top repetition of square framing for the secondary artwork inserts color coordination between the yellow header and the yellow accents in the bottom right graphic combine a dark group portrait with vibrant primary colored geometric overlays and heavy rounded display type to create a retro reissue aesthetic

recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered composition featuring a low-key group portrait of a 1960s-style male band on the left, contrasted with two bright red square graphic inserts on the right, all framed by a bold yellow header and black background.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the dark, moody photography and the vibrant, flat-color graphic panels.
Hierarchy established by the oversized blue display type at the top.
Repetition of square framing for the secondary artwork inserts.
Color coordination between the yellow header and the yellow accents in the bottom-right graphic.
coreInvariants: Black background for the main body
Low-key lighting on the band members

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Band portrait occupies the left two-thirds; graphic squares stacked vertically on the right third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large blue title at the top center-left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the blue title, moves down through the band members, then shifts right to the red graphic panels.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black shadows between band members provide separation and depth.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright Red (graphic panels and secondary text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in graphic elements versus low saturation, warm-toned photography.

letterConstructionRules: Display type features rounded terminals and a playful, slightly irregular baseline.
Secondary text uses high-contrast, heavy slab-serifs for readability against red.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase 'G' and 'R' in the main title have exaggerated, friendly curves.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Playful rounded display paired with rigid, functional slab-serifs.

preserve: Rounded feel of the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, rounded, playful 60s/70s display style.
Matches the sturdy, mechanical slab-serif used for the red text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a collage with a black background. On the left, place a low-key, warm-toned photograph of five young men in 1960s attire. On the right, stack two bright red squares with white borders. Add a thick yellow horizontal bar across the top.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large royal blue rounded sans-serif title over the yellow bar and black background. Inside the yellow bar, center a red slab-serif subtitle. Add a red circular badge at the bottom center with white text.

verificationChecks: Is the main title blue and rounded?
Are there two distinct red graphic squares on the right?
Is the band photography low-key and warm?

adjustableVariables: Content of the red graphic squares
Specific shade of blue for the title
mustRedesign: Specific character illustrations in the red squares
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the yellow bar spans the full width.
Check that the red squares have clean white borders.
Verify the blue text is thick and legible.
Confirm the band photo looks like a vintage film print.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a dark group portrait with vibrant primary-colored geometric overlays and heavy rounded display type to create a retro-reissue aesthetic.
